summary: Know who you're talking to, answer faster, and help people help themselves. This release adds person cards with an organisation privacy setting, personal saved replies for staff, Help Center suggestions while creating a ticket, and tightens who can moderate conversations.
upgrade_notes: Rehearsal manifest for upgrade testing. Point a test installation at it with COMPDESK_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL; never at production. Back up PostgreSQL, private attachments, uploaded branding, and the private configuration volume together before upgrading.
